biography: Camille Bergue has 20 years of experience in real estate development, including industrial, light industrial, farmland, and office asset classes. She has a minimum of 8 years in entitlements and permitting, and 18-19 years in lease negotiations across various contract types. Her current role is Data Center Land Acquisition Manager at Microsoft, where she focuses on hyperscale data center projects primarily in Western Europe. She is an individual contributor and reports to John Belton, Head of Development. She has previously worked at Cushman & Wakefield, Danone, and Hermes.
